comments.headline: Proposed residential use terminology not LDC-defined
comments.summary: Site Data Table and Parking Data section identify the residential use as 'Multi-Family Residential' (hyphenated), but LDC § 25-2-3 requires exact terminology: 'Multifamily Residential', 'Condominium Residential', or 'Townhouse Residential'. Correct to the applicable LDC-defined term.

details.text: Site Data Table uses 'Multi-Family Residential' with hyphen instead of LDC-defined 'Multifamily Residential' (no hyphen, one word). Update all references in Site Data Table and application documents to match exact LDC § 25-2-3 terminology.

runComments.comment: Site Data Table identifies use as 'Multi-Family Residential' (with hyphen) instead of the LDC § 25-2-3 defined term 'Multifamily Residential' (without hyphen). While the designation is specific and clearly references multifamily residential use, it does not exactly match the LDC-defined terminology required for compliance. Correct to 'Multifamily Residential' per LDC § 25-2-3.

Site Data Table identifies use as 'Multi-Family Residential' which is not a specific LDC-defined use name. All proposed uses must be identified using exact terminology from LDC § 25-2-3 (Multifamily Residential, Condominium Residential, or Townhouse Residential), not generic variations with hyphens or capitalization differences. Update Site Data Table and application to specify the exact LDC-defined residential use sub-type.

Site Data Table lists the proposed use as 'Multi-Family Residential' (with hyphen), but the correct LDC-defined term per § 25-2-3 is 'Multifamily Residential' (no hyphen, one word for 'Multifamily'). Update to use the exact LDC-defined terminology.

details.text: Parking Data section references residential use with generic or unclear terminology. Ensure the specific LDC sub-type (Multifamily, Condominium, or Townhouse Residential per § 25-2-3) is clearly specified to match the Site Data Table and application designation.

runComments.comment: Residential use sub-type is listed as 'Multi-Family Residential' (with hyphen) instead of the LDC § 25-2-3 defined term 'Multifamily Residential' (without hyphen). The three acceptable residential sub-types per LDC § 25-2-3 are Multifamily Residential, Condominium Residential, or Townhouse Residential. Correct the Site Data Table to use 'Multifamily Residential' without the hyphen.

Residential use designation lacks the specific LDC sub-type classification required by LDC § 25-2-3. The Site Data Table and application must explicitly identify the use as either 'Multifamily Residential', 'Condominium Residential', or 'Townhouse Residential'. Generic designations or variations of these terms (e.g., 'Multi-Family Residential', 'Residential', 'Apartments', 'Townhomes') are not acceptable. Clarify and update all documents to specify which of the three residential sub-types applies to this project.

Site Data Table shows 'Multi-Family Residential' but the correct LDC-defined sub-type per § 25-2-3 must be specified as 'Multifamily Residential', 'Condominium Residential', or 'Townhouse Residential'. Update to the correct LDC term formatted as written in § 25-2-3 (one word for 'Multifamily', no hyphen).

comments.headline: Adjacent property use labels lack LDC-defined terms
comments.summary: Site plan labels adjacent properties with generic descriptions ('Existing Apartment Building'), project names ('Clarion Ridge Condominiums'), or zoning codes (SF-3, MF-3-CO) instead of specific LDC-defined use classifications. All adjacent properties must be labeled per LDC §§ 25-2-3 through 25-2-6.

details.text: North and east boundaries labeled 'Existing Apartment Building' need explicit LDC classification (either 'Multifamily Residential' or 'Condominium Residential'). South labeled '(Single-Family)' must be 'Single Family Residential'. Replace all generic labels and zoning codes with applicable LDC-defined use types per §§ 25-2-3 through 25-2-6.

runComments.comment: Adjacent and existing property uses are labeled with generic designations rather than specific LDC-defined use classifications. Examples: 'Multi-Family' (should be 'Multifamily Residential'), 'Single-Family' (should be 'Single-Family Residential'), and 'Existing Apartment Building' (not an LDC use category). All adjacent property labels must use specific LDC §§ 25-2-3 through 25-2-6 classifications per the standard (e.g., 'Multifamily Residential', 'Single-Family Residential', 'General Office').

Adjacent property uses are not labeled using LDC-defined use classifications. Site plan shows adjacent properties identified as 'Existing Apartment Building' and 'Clarion Ridge Condominiums' or by zoning designation only (SF-3, MF-3-CO). These must be relabeled with specific LDC use types: 'Multifamily Residential' for apartment complexes, 'Condominium Residential' for condominium projects, 'Single Family Residential' for single-family areas, and appropriate commercial/office/industrial classifications per LDC §§ 25-2-4 and 25-2-5 for other uses. Update site plan to replace zoning codes and descriptive project names with proper LDC use classifications for all adjacent properties.

Adjacent property uses are labeled generically or incompletely: north and east show 'Existing Apartment Building' instead of the specific LDC classification (either 'Multifamily Residential' or 'Condominium Residential'); south shows '(Single-Family)' instead of 'Single Family Residential'. Update all adjacent property labels on the site plan to use specific LDC-defined use classifications per §§ 25-2-3 through 25-2-6.

comments.headline: Parking table use category not Appendix A-defined
comments.summary: Parking summary table lists use as generic 'Land Use Residential' or 'Residential' instead of the exact use name category defined in LDC Chapter 25-6 Appendix A. Specify the applicable Appendix A parking use category.
comments.attn: Run 2 of 3 did not flag this issue; verify whether Appendix A category is specified elsewhere in parking documentation.

details.text: Parking summary table uses generic terminology ('Land Use Residential' or 'Residential') without specifying the exact use name category from LDC Chapter 25-6 Appendix A. Update to the specific Appendix A category applicable to this multifamily residential use.

runComments.comment: Parking summary table lists 'Land Use Residential' which is generic and not a specific LDC Chapter 25-6, Appendix A parking category. Per the standard, parking tables must use exact Appendix A use name categories. Specify the exact Appendix A parking category for the multifamily residential use (e.g., 'Multi-family residential' or the specific category name used in Appendix A).

Parking summary table lists the land use as 'Residential', which is a generic term. Per LDC Chapter 25-6, Appendix A, parking tables must use the exact use name category (e.g., 'Residential Dwelling Units' or the specific category defined in Appendix A for multifamily residential uses). Update parking table with the specific use category from Appendix A.
